There exists no method in our application to disable or enable full-body tracking at run-time. We expect that when you run VRChat, you start the application with the tracker setup you will use until you restart the application next.

details:
Sometimes it's desirable to temporarily disable FBT - perhaps you want to wear an avatar that doesn't support fbt, or maybe you just don't want to bother calibrating for an avatar that only has a humanoid rig for technical reasons. Previously this could be accomplished by opening the steamvr overlay, but now that avatar loading is super fast this is quite difficult.

Please add a way to temporarily disable FBT. Ideally, this should store the calibration of your last FBT avatar so you can switch back quickly, as the dashboard hack does today.

たまに、一時的フルトラを解除したくなるときがあります。今はアバター読み込み中スチームダッシュボードを開くことでできますが、アバター読み込みが早くなったことでかなり難しくなっています。

なので、一時的にフルトラを解除する機能を正式に実装ください。できれば、今のダッシュボード裏技みたいに、最後にフルトラで使ったアバターのキャリブレーションを保持してほしいです。
title: Add control to temporarily disable FBT
